items.prompt: The parser gives PUT A 004 as string tokens. What does a later GET A print in the shown implementation?

options.why: int("004") stores integer 4, and the GET formats that stored integer as decimal text.
That would preserve the raw token rather than the explicit integer conversion.
A successful PUT creates A before the GET.
Leading zeros do not turn the whole valid decimal token into zero.
